program.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Does the edited image show the source mug itself moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely adding another mug there?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source and edited images to identify the source mug and assess its position relative to the headphones. Pass only when visual evidence reliably supports that the source mug itself is now to the right of the headphones. Fail when evidence reliably establishes that the source mug was not moved there, such as a clearly identifiable source mug remaining at its former position while a different mug appears on the right. Use unknown when the former-position blur, appearance changes, or other ambiguity prevents reliable determination of the source mug's identity or movement. A mug appearing on the right alone does not establish that the source mug was moved.
nodes.binding: The mug visible in the source image (blue, left of the headphones) and the headphones in the source and edited images; compare the source mug's identity and position across images.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

d1: The binding is truncated and underspecified: it names the source mug and headphones but does not clearly anchor their corresponding regions in both images. Repair it as a typed cross-image binding that identifies the source blue mug and the same headphones, while allowing for scale, lighting, and appearance changes. The trace reports a right-side mug but cannot establish it is the source mug; the edited image also visibly retains a blue, blurred patch at the mug’s former left position. Treat that as evidence to investigate, not proof of identity or movement: compare distinctive shape/handle and spatial correspondence, and distinguish a reliably identifiable unmoved source mug plus a separate right-side mug from an ambiguous blur or transformed mug. Preserve unknown when identity truly cannot be resolved. The valid queried trace has no transport, schema, or dependency failure; do not alter the criterion merely to force agreement with the partial reference label, which constrains the aggregate but is not atomic ground truth.

observations.evidence: The edited image shows a mug to the right of the headphones, but the source mug's former position on the left is only a blue, blurred patch. The visible right-side mug differs in appearance from the source blue mug, yet the blur and appearance changes prevent reliably determining whether the source mug itself was moved or another mug was added.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image show the mug positioned to the right of the headphones, regardless of whether it can be identified as the original mug?
findings.criteria: Compare the visible mug and headphones in the edited image. Pass if a mug is clearly to the right of the headphones; fail if no mug is to their right; use unknown if their relative positions cannot be determined. This checks the requested final spatial relation, not whether the original mug was moved.
findings.evidence: The edited image visibly contains a mug to the right of the headphones, as well as another mug to their left. The source image has one blue mug left of the headphones.
findings.rationale: The existing d1 check focuses on whether the source mug itself was moved and returns unknown because of identity ambiguity. A separate check of the explicitly requested final relation could establish progress or fulfillment even if original-object identity remains unresolved.

transactions.reason: The existing check appropriately preserves uncertainty about whether the source mug itself was moved, but its binding should explicitly anchor the source blue mug and the same headphones across both images. The edited image shows a blurred blue patch at the mug’s former location and a distinct-looking mug on the right; neither alone resolves identity. Add a separate required condition for the requested final spatial relation, without treating that relation as proof that the original mug was moved.
